newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Rain triggers flash floods in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Rain triggers flash floods in Bangladesh.

text.p: Torrential rains have triggered flash floods in southeastern Bangladesh, making hundreds of families homeless, officials said on Thursday.
There have been no reports of death or injuries so far, but concern is mounting as weather forecasters predict more rain, they said.
"The monsoon is very active this year. We expect many showers in the next few days," one meteorology official in Chittagong said.
Many rivers in the area have burst their banks, flooding villages and sweeping away a bridge on the highway between Chittagong port and Cox's Bazar port town.
Civil aviation officials said Bangladesh national airline Biman has suspended or delayed flights to Chittagong and Cox's Bazar, which are at the heart of the downpours.
Cargo handling at the Chittagong port has also been hampered.
The flooding has hit areas in the country which are still recovering from a severe cyclone on May 19 that killed over 100 people and injured thousands.
